gloss: roasting machine; roaster (for coffee or tea)

definitions.explanation: A machine used to roast raw materials, most commonly coffee beans, applying controlled heat to develop flavor and aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{焙煎機|ばいせんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a roasting machine inside the shop.

examples.english: Recently, small home-use roasting machines have become available.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧ (roasting) and ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). Most commonly associated with coffee culture, where {自家焙煎|じかばいせん} (in-house roasting) cafés have become popular in Japan. Can also refer to machines for roasting tea leaves (⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧), barley (⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧), or other foods.
